Ensure the TLS socket + server are closed. {"parentUuid":"01cc2a89-7f49-4ed7-8fc1-4578c2fe451b","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a0628aae67f1a382e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0128MzJhx5YfpeDAwGRH7dhx","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"PushNotifier (Phase 7, WS-D D-vi) — pushes to the phone when an A2/A3 item QUEUES, fed by the\n2\tSHARED P0 `SpineTailer` (the same primitive the UI SSE feed uses). The push carries ONLY\n3\t`{seq, tier, kind}` — never the subject, never the payload, never a secret — so nothing sensitive\n4\tcrosses even the WireGuard tunnel; the phone fetches any detail on demand over the daemon API. No\n5\tcloud push (that would egress the private subject off owned hardware).\"\"\"\n6\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n7\t\n8\tfrom typing import List, Optional\n9\t\n10\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n11\tfrom ..spine.tail import SpineTailer\n12\t\n13\t\n14\tclass PushNotifier:\n15\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: Optional[int] = None):\n16\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n17\t        start = since_seq if since_seq is not None else self.store.next_seq - 1\n18\t        self.tailer = SpineTailer(self.store, since_seq=start)\n19\t\n20\t    def poll(self) -> List[dict]:\n21\t        \"\"\"New pushes since the last poll: one per newly-QUEUED A2/A3 item, minimal fields only.\"\"\"\n22\t        out: List[dict] = []\n23\t        for ev in self.tailer.poll():\n24\t            rec = self.store.get(ev[\"seq\"])\n25\t            p = rec.payload if rec else {}\n26\t            if (p.get(\"decision\") == \"queued\" and p.get(\"status\") == \"awaiting-approval\"\n27\t                    and p.get(\"tier\") in (\"A2\", \"A3\")):\n28\t                out.append({\"seq\": ev[\"seq\"], \"tier\": p.get(\"tier\"), \"kind\": ev[\"kind\"]})   # no subject/secret\n29\t        return out\n30\t"}]},"uuid":"d0df0008-7d86-4b10-b17c-822d042bf80f","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:19.233Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"01cc2a89-7f49-4ed7-8fc1-4578c2fe451b","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"c1d534a1-8a0d-44d1-a93b-8c3e8f2e00fa","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a0628aae67f1a382e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01Gt5g2FcckQ2BmtHKmidK78","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"SpineTailer (Phase 7, P0.2) — a live tail over the append-only, poll-only spine with an HONEST,\n2\ttwo-layer integrity model (red-pen-hardened: unkeyed hashes alone cannot resist a writer who can\n3\trecompute them):\n4\t\n5\t  • `integrity_ok` (CHEAP, per-poll, unkeyed) — per-record binding+derivation (`verify_record`) plus\n6\t    cross-record LINKAGE (this record's `prev_hash` == the last emitted `entry_hash`). This catches\n7\t    ACCIDENTAL corruption, a naive stale-field tamper, a deletion/reorder/gap. It does NOT resist a\n8\t    file-writer who recomputes cert_digest+entry_hash (a tip tamper or a forward-cascaded fork stays\n9\t    internally consistent) — so it is necessary but not sufficient, and is never presented as proof\n10\t    of authenticity on its own.\n11\t\n12\t  • `anchored` (KEYED, via `check_anchor`) — the owner-SIGNED head (`checkpoint.classify_head` /\n13\t    `verify_head`, Ed25519 1-of-1 trust root, monotonic `last_seq`) notarizes the prefix\n14\t    [0 .. signed_last_seq]. A recompute-fork or truncation AT OR BELOW the signed head is\n15\t    unforgeable without the owner key and is caught here; a monotonic high-water catches a rollback\n16\t    of even the un-notarized tail. Records with seq > signed_last_seq are the FRESH, not-yet-keyed\n17\t    tail — emitted `anchored=False` (well-formed but not tamper-proof), keyed at the next `sigil sign`.\n18\t\n19\tA consumer (UI/mobile) shows `integrity_ok=False` as \"integrity broken\", and treats only\n20\t`anchored=True` records as owner-notarized truth; the un-notarized tail is labelled as such, never\n21\tdressed up as proven. One primitive, two consumers — the UI SSE feed and the mobile push notifier —\n22\tboth drive `poll()` on a tick and fan events out via `Broadcaster`.\"\"\"\n23\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n24\t\n25\tfrom collections import deque\n26\tfrom typing import Optional\n27\t\n28\tfrom ..config import HEAD_PATH\n29\tfrom ..reuse import SignedChainHead\n30\tfrom ..reuse.chain import _GENESIS_PREV\n31\tfrom .checkpoint import classify_head, trust_root\n32\tfrom .store import SpineStore\n33\tfrom .verify import verify_record\n34\t\n35\t\n36\tdef _shape(record, *, integrity_ok: bool, integrity_reason: str, anchored: bool) -> dict:\n37\t    \"\"\"The cited atom shape emitted to consumers. `integrity_ok` = unkeyed well-formedness;\n38\t    `anchored` = covered by the owner-signed head (keyed). `text` is best-effort, never fabricated.\"\"\"\n39\t    return {\n40\t        \"seq\": record.seq, \"kind\": record.kind, \"source\": record.source, \"actor\": record.actor,\n41\t        \"ts\": record.ts, \"entry_hash\": record.entry_hash, \"text\": record.text(),\n42\t        \"integrity_ok\": integrity_ok, \"integrity_reason\": integrity_reason, \"anchored\": anchored,\n43\t    }\n44\t\n45\t\n46\tclass SpineTailer:\n47\t    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: int = -1,\n48\t                 signed_head: Optional[SignedChainHead] = None, tr=None):\n49\t        \"\"\"Emit records with seq > `since_seq`. `signed_head`/`tr` may be injected (tests); otherwise\n50\t        the owner-signed head is loaded from `HEAD_PATH` + the persisted trust root.\"\"\"\n51\t        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n52\t        self.cursor = since_seq\n53\t        if since_seq < 0:\n54\t            self._last_hash = _GENESIS_PREV\n55\t        else:\n56\t            anchor = self.store.get(since_seq)\n57\t            self._last_hash = anchor.entry_hash if anchor else _GENESIS_PREV\n58\t        self._injected_head = signed_head\n59\t        self._injected_tr = tr\n60\t        self._high_water = -1                           # monotonic anti-rollback water mark\n61\t        self._signed_last_seq = -1\n62\t        self.check_anchor()                             # establish the initial keyed anchor (reads disk)\n63\t\n64\t    def poll(self) -> list[dict]:\n65\t        \"\"\"Newly-appended records (seq > cursor), each with the cheap `integrity_ok` verdict and the\n66\t        `anchored` (keyed) flag from the last `check_anchor`. On an integrity failure the event is\n67\t        emitted flagged (not dropped); the cursor still advances so the feed never re-emits or stalls.\"\"\"\n68\t        out: list[dict] = []\n69\t        for r in self.store.iter_records(since_seq=self.cursor):\n70\t            atom_ok, reason = verify_record(r)\n71\t            if r.prev_hash != self._last_hash:\n72\t                ok = False\n73\t                reason = f\"linkage break at seq {r.seq}: prev_hash != last emitted entry_hash (rewind/fork/gap)\"\n74\t            else:\n75\t                ok = atom_ok\n76\t            out.append(_shape(r, integrity_ok=ok, integrity_reason=reason,\n77\t                              anchored=(r.seq <= self._signed_last_seq)))\n78\t            self.cursor = r.seq\n79\t            self._last_hash = r.entry_hash\n80\t        return out\n81\t\n82\t    def check_anchor(self) -> dict:\n83\t        \"\"\"The KEYED verdict. Verify the owner-signed head over the current chain (unforgeable without\n84\t        the owner key): a recompute-fork or truncation at/below the signed head → `anchor_ok=False`;\n85\t        a monotonic high-water rollback of even the un-notarized tail → `rollback` set. Updates\n86\t        `signed_last_seq` so `poll()` can flag records beyond it as the un-notarized tail.\"\"\"\n87\t        entries = self.store.entries()                  # FRESH read from disk (not the cached head)\n88\t        head_seq = entries[-1].seq if entries else -1\n89\t        rollback = None\n90\t        if head_seq < self._high_water:\n91\t            rollback = f\"ROLLBACK: on-disk head seq {head_seq} < monotonic high-water {self._high_water}\"\n92\t        else:\n93\t            self._high_water = head_seq\n94\t        head, tr = self._resolve_head()\n95\t        if head is None:\n96\t            self._signed_last_seq = -1\n97\t            return {\"anchor_ok\": False, \"signed_last_seq\": -1, \"rollback\": rollback,\n98\t                    \"reason\": \"no signed checkpoint — the live tail is well-formed but UN-NOTARIZED \"\n99\t                              \"(run `sigil sign` to anchor)\"}\n100\t        try:\n101\t            ok, reason = classify_head(head, entries, tr)\n102\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — a malformed head must FAIL closed, never crash the feed\n103\t            self._signed_last_seq = -1\n104\t            return {\"anchor_ok\": False, \"signed_last_seq\": -1, \"rollback\": rollback,\n105\t                    \"reason\": f\"anchor unverifiable ({e})\"}\n106\t        self._signed_last_seq = head.last_seq if ok else -1\n107\t        return {\"anchor_ok\": ok and rollback is None, \"signed_last_seq\": self._signed_last_seq,\n108\t                \"rollback\": rollback, \"reason\": reason}\n109\t\n110\t    def _resolve_head(self):\n111\t        if self._injected_head is not None:\n112\t            return self._injected_head, self._injected_tr\n113\t        try:\n114\t            if not HEAD_PATH.exists():\n115\t                return None, None\n116\t            head = SignedChainHead.model_validate_json(HEAD_PATH.read_text(encoding=\"utf-8\"))\n117\t            return head, trust_root()\n118\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — no/broken head → unkeyed live tail (honest, fail-closed)\n119\t            return None, None\n120\t\n121\t\n122\tclass Broadcaster:\n123\t    \"\"\"Fan-out of tail events to N subscribers with bounded per-subscriber queues. On overflow the\n124\t    oldest events are dropped and the subscriber is marked `lagged` so it resyncs from the cursor\n125\t    (never a fabricated 'you saw everything').\"\"\"\n126\t    def __init__(self, maxlen: int = 512):\n127\t        self.maxlen = maxlen\n128\t        self._subs: dict[int, deque] = {}\n129\t        self._lagged: dict[int, bool] = {}\n130\t        self._next_id = 0\n131\t\n132\t    def subscribe(self) -> int:\n133\t        sid = self._next_id\n134\t        self._next_id += 1\n135\t        self._subs[sid] = deque(maxlen=self.maxlen)\n136\t        self._lagged[sid] = False\n137\t        return sid\n138\t\n139\t    def unsubscribe(self, sid: int) -> None:\n140\t        self._subs.pop(sid, None)\n141\t        self._lagged.pop(sid, None)\n142\t\n143\t    def publish(self, events: list[dict]) -> None:\n144\t        for sid, q in self._subs.items():\n145\t            for ev in events:\n146\t                if len(q) == self.maxlen:        # would drop the oldest → the subscriber lagged\n147\t                    self._lagged[sid] = True\n148\t                q.append(ev)\n149\t\n150\t    def drain(self, sid: int) -> tuple[list[dict], bool]:\n151\t        \"\"\"Return (events, lagged) and clear both. `lagged=True` tells the consumer to resync.\"\"\"\n152\t        q = self._subs.get(sid)\n153\t        if q is None:\n154\t            return [], False\n155\t        events = list(q)\n156\t        q.clear()\n157\t        lagged = self._lagged.get(sid, False)\n158\t        self._lagged[sid] = False\n159\t        return events, lagged\n160\t"}]},"uuid":"a7cb80d6-90f9-45fb-b008-2def69f4e83a","timestamp":"2026-07-19T09:12:19.235Z","sourceToolAssistantUUID":"c1d534a1-8a0d-44d1-a93b-8c3e8f2e00fa","userType":"external","entrypoint":"claude-vscode","cwd":"/home/kali/Pictures/PENTEST-main","sessionId":"7758e121-f349-47d5-886b-6bb5a1d60e27","version":"2.1.214","gitBranch":"main","slug":"parsed-popping-lemur"}
{"parentUuid":"ef9ffc84-fdf7-465c-921c-82581af40339","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a0628aae67f1a382e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_014j1rH7vp3R8xYoHkMarnFX","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"The SIGIL bridge server (Phase 9 W1-B) — the WireGuard-bound HTTP transport that lets an\n2\tAUTHORIZED phone reach the desktop `BridgeDaemon`. It forks the WS-C glass-cockpit server\n3\t(`sigil.ui.server`) verbatim in shape (ThreadingHTTPServer + BaseHTTPRequestHandler, the strict\n4\tCSP/nosniff/no-referrer header set, the body cap + 30s timeout, the never-log-auth `log_message`,\n5\tthe SSE structure, the anti-DNS-rebinding Host/Origin/Referer gate) and changes ONLY three things:\n6\t\n7\t  • THE BIND. It binds a `bind_ok` address (loopback or a PRIVATE/WireGuard address) — NEVER\n8\t    0.0.0.0 / a public address. The constructor asserts this; the CLI asserts it too. This is the\n9\t    non-negotiable exposure guard: the tunnel, not the transport, is the network boundary.\n10\t\n11\t  • THE AUTH. There is NO wire bearer secret (the ui's printed token is gone). Authentication IS a\n12\t    per-request Ed25519 signature the phone makes with ITS OWN owner-authorized device key — the\n13\t    Wave-1 device envelope (`bridge.envelope`). The server verifies the signature against the\n14\t    owner-minted authorized-device set (recomputed PER REQUEST so a revocation takes effect at once),\n15\t    binds the authenticated envelope `action` to the endpoint it hit (a `read:pending` envelope can\n16\t    never reach the more-sensitive `read:recall`), applies a wallclock timestamp-freshness window\n17\t    (injectable clock), and for EFFECTFUL actions (panic/relay) additionally runs the envelope's\n18\t    strict monotonic-nonce replay gate (`consume(effectful=True)`). The owner trust-root is NEVER used\n19\t    to sign anything here — the phone signs, the server only verifies.\n20\t\n21\t  • THE ALLOWLIST. The anti-rebind Host/Origin allowlist is derived from the REAL bound address (plus\n22\t    the loopback pair when bound to loopback, for dev), not a hardcoded 127.0.0.1.\n23\t\n24\tEverything sensitive stays off the minimal frames: `/api/pending` and the SSE stream carry only\n25\t`{seq, tier, kind}` — never a subject, never a payload, never a secret. `serve()` now wraps the\n26\ttransport in an owner-PINNED self-signed TLS cert (the phone PWA needs a secure context — https or\n27\tlocalhost — to install and register a service worker; over a bare WireGuard IP that means self-signed\n28\tTLS whose sha256 fingerprint the owner pins once, stable across restarts). `build_server` itself\n29\tstays plain HTTP so the in-tunnel test harness is unchanged and TLS can be terminated upstream if\n30\tpreferred. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n31\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n32\t\n33\timport base64\n34\timport ipaddress\n35\timport json\n36\timport os\n37\timport time\n38\tfrom http.server import BaseHTTPRequestHandler, ThreadingHTTPServer\n39\tfrom pathlib import Path\n40\tfrom urllib.parse import parse_qs, urlparse\n41\t\n42\tfrom ..config import SPINE_PATH\n43\tfrom ..governor.identity import owner_pubkey\n44\tfrom ..mesh import authorized_devices\n45\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n46\tfrom ..spine.verify import verify_record\n47\tfrom .daemon import BridgeDaemon, bind_ok\n48\tfrom .envelope import consume, verify_envelope\n49\tfrom .notifier import PushNotifier\n50\t\n51\t_WEBAPP = Path(__file__).parent / \"webapp\"       # the PWA is a later slice — served if present, else 404\n52\t_CSP = \"default-src 'self'; base-uri 'none'; form-action 'none'; frame-ancestors 'none'\"\n53\t_DEFAULT_PORT = 8722\n54\t_TS_WINDOW = 120.0                               # ± seconds a request timestamp may differ from the server clock\n55\t\n56\t# Each network endpoint declares the ONE envelope action that authorizes it. Binding the\n57\t# authenticated action to the endpoint stops a captured lesser-scoped envelope (e.g. `read:pending`,\n58\t# which leaks only {seq,tier,kind}) from being replayed against a more-sensitive endpoint (e.g.\n59\t# `read:recall`, which surfaces the owner's on-screen OCR history). `/api/graph` piggybacks on the\n60\t# `read:snapshot` scope: graph returns only aggregate health, strictly LESS sensitive than the\n61\t# snapshot, so a snapshot-scoped envelope reaching it is not an escalation (and a lesser envelope\n62\t# still cannot reach it).\n63\t_READ_ACTION = {\n64\t    \"/api/pending\": \"read:pending\",\n65\t    \"/api/snapshot\": \"read:snapshot\",\n66\t    \"/api/graph\": \"read:snapshot\",\n67\t    \"/api/stream\": \"read:stream\",\n68\t    \"/api/recall\": \"read:recall\",\n69\t}\n70\t\n71\t\n72\tclass BridgeServer(ThreadingHTTPServer):\n73\t    daemon_threads = True\n74\t\n75\t    def __init__(self, addr, handler, *, spine_path, trusted_pubkey=None, clock=None,\n76\t                 ts_window: float = _TS_WINDOW):\n77\t        host = addr[0]\n78\t        if not bind_ok(host):\n79\t            raise ValueError(\n80\t                f\"refusing to bind {host!r}: the bridge binds loopback or a PRIVATE (WireGuard) \"\n81\t                f\"address only — never 0.0.0.0 / an unspecified / a public address\")\n82\t        super().__init__(addr, handler)\n83\t        self.spine_path = Path(spine_path)\n84\t        # the owner PUBLIC key is the trust anchor (injectable for tests); NO private key ever lives here\n85\t        self.trusted_pubkey = trusted_pubkey if trusted_pubkey is not None else owner_pubkey()\n86\t        self.clock = clock or time.time          # injectable wallclock so the freshness gate is deterministic\n87\t        self.ts_window = ts_window\n88\t        port = self.server_address[1]            # the ACTUAL bound port (correct even for port 0)\n89\t        hosts = {f\"{host}:{port}\"}\n90\t        origins = {f\"http://{host}:{port}\"}\n91\t        if ipaddress.ip_address(host).is_loopback:   # dev convenience only — not added for a WG bind\n92\t            hosts |= {f\"127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"localhost:{port}\"}\n93\t            origins |= {f\"http://127.0.0.1:{port}\", f\"http://localhost:{port}\"}\n94\t        self.allowed_hosts = frozenset(hosts)\n95\t        self.allowed_origins = frozenset(origins)\n96\t\n97\t    def store(self) -> SpineStore:\n98\t        return SpineStore(self.spine_path)       # fresh read each request (cheap, current)\n99\t\n100\t    def daemon(self) -> BridgeDaemon:\n101\t        return BridgeDaemon(self.store(), trusted_pubkey=self.trusted_pubkey)\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef _json_bytes(obj) -> bytes:\n105\t    return json.dumps(obj, ensure_ascii=False).encode(\"utf-8\")\n106\t\n107\t\n108\tclass Handler(BaseHTTPRequestHandler):\n109\t    server_version = \"sigil-bridge/1.0\"\n110\t    timeout = 30                                  # per-connection socket timeout (no hung reader)\n111\t    _MAX_BODY = 65536                             # bodies are tiny; cap to avoid a Content-Length hang/alloc\n112\t\n113\t    # never log auth (an envelope can ride in ?env= for SSE; never write it to a log)\n114\t    def log_message(self, fmt, *args):  # noqa: A003\n115\t        pass\n116\t\n117\t    # --- request helpers --------------------------------------------------------------------------\n118\t    def _query(self) -> dict:\n119\t        return parse_qs(urlparse(self.path).query)\n120\t\n121\t    def _authorized_now(self):\n122\t        \"\"\"The owner-minted authorized-device set, recomputed PER REQUEST — a revoke takes effect now.\"\"\"\n123\t        return authorized_devices(self.server.store(), self.server.trusted_pubkey)\n124\t\n125\t    def _envelope_payload(self):\n126\t        \"\"\"The device envelope: base64url of canonical JSON, in `X-SIGIL-Envelope` (GET/POST) or the\n127\t        `?env=` query (SSE, which cannot set a header). Returns the payload dict, or None if absent/\n128\t        malformed (fail-closed — the caller denies).\"\"\"\n129\t        raw = self.headers.get(\"X-SIGIL-Envelope\") or (self._query().get(\"env\", [\"\"])[0])\n130\t        if not raw:\n131\t            return None\n132\t        try:\n133\t            data = base64.urlsafe_b64decode(raw + \"=\" * (-len(raw) % 4))\n134\t            payload = json.loads(data)\n135\t        except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any decode/parse failure is an unauthenticated request\n136\t            return None\n137\t        return payload if isinstance(payload, dict) else None\n138\t\n139\t    def _fresh(self, core) -> bool:\n140\t        \"\"\"The server-layer wallclock freshness window (the envelope module is pure — it never reads a\n141\t        clock — so freshness lives HERE). A non-numeric / far-off timestamp fails closed.\"\"\"\n142\t        try:\n143\t            ts = float(core.get(\"ts\"))\n144\t        except (TypeError, ValueError):\n145\t            return False\n146\t        return abs(self.server.clock() - ts) <= self.server.ts_window\n147\t\n148\t    def _authed(self, action: str):\n149\t        \"\"\"Authenticate a READ: verify the device signature, apply freshness, bind the action to this\n150\t        endpoint. Reads are side-effect-free, so they are NOT receipted (no spine write per GET) — the\n151\t        freshness window is their replay bound. Returns the core, or None after sending a deny.\"\"\"\n152\t        payload = self._envelope_payload()\n153\t        if payload is None:\n154\t            self._deny(401, \"missing/invalid device envelope\")\n155\t            return None\n156\t        ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, self._authorized_now())\n157\t        if not ok:\n158\t            self._deny(401, f\"unauthenticated: {core}\")\n159\t            return None\n160\t        if not self._fresh(core):\n161\t            self._deny(401, \"stale request (timestamp outside freshness window)\")\n162\t            return None\n163\t        if core.get(\"action\") != action:\n164\t            self._deny(403, \"envelope action does not authorize this endpoint\")\n165\t            return None\n166\t        return core\n167\t\n168\t    def _authed_effectful(self, action: str):\n169\t        \"\"\"Authenticate an EFFECTFUL request (panic/relay): verify + freshness + endpoint-bind, then run\n170\t        the envelope's strict monotonic-nonce replay gate and receipt it on the spine\n171\t        (`consume(effectful=True)`). A replayed/stale-nonce envelope is refused. Returns core or None.\"\"\"\n172\t        payload = self._envelope_payload()\n173\t        if payload is None:\n174\t            self._deny(401, \"missing/invalid device envelope\")\n175\t            return None\n176\t        authorized = self._authorized_now()\n177\t        ok, core = verify_envelope(payload, authorized)\n178\t        if not ok:\n179\t            self._deny(401, f\"unauthenticated: {core}\")\n180\t            return None\n181\t        if not self._fresh(core):\n182\t            self._deny(401, \"stale request (timestamp outside freshness window)\")\n183\t            return None\n184\t        if core.get(\"action\") != action:\n185\t            self._deny(403, \"envelope action does not authorize this endpoint\")\n186\t            return None\n187\t        try:\n188\t            return consume(self.server.store(), payload, authorized, effectful=True)\n189\t        except ValueError as e:                   # replay / invalid nonce (fail-closed)\n190\t            self._deny(409, f\"refused: {str(e)[:120]}\")\n191\t            return None\n192\t        except Exception as e:  # noqa: BLE001 — never let a consume error crash the handler (no RemoteDisconnected)\n193\t            self._deny(400, f\"refused: {type(e).__name__}\")\n194\t            return None\n195\t\n196\t    def _rebind_ok(self) -> bool:\n197\t        \"\"\"The anti-DNS-rebinding gate (ui `_action_ok` logic, minus the token — the envelope is the\n198\t        credential): the `Host` must be in the WG-derived allowlist, an `Origin`, if present, must\n199\t        EXACT-match an allowed origin (a prefix like `http://IP:PORT.evil.com` must NOT pass), and a\n200\t        `Referer`, if present, must sit under an allowed origin. Applied to the whole POST action\n201\t        plane as defense-in-depth.\"\"\"\n202\t        if self.headers.get(\"Host\", \"\") not in self.server.allowed_hosts:\n203\t            return False\n204\t        o = self.headers.get(\"Origin\") or \"\"\n205\t        ref = self.headers.get(\"Referer\") or \"\"\n206\t        if o and o not in self.server.allowed_origins:\n207\t            return False\n208\t        if ref and not any(ref.startswith(a + \"/\") or ref == a for a in self.server.allowed_origins):\n209\t            return False\n210\t        return True\n211\t\n212\t    # --- response helpers -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n213\t    def _send(self, code: int, body: bytes, ctype=\"application/json\"):\n214\t        self.send_response(code)\n215\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Type\", ctype)\n216\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Length\", str(len(body)))\n217\t        self.send_header(\"Content-Security-Policy\", _CSP)\n218\t        self.send_header(\"X-Content-Type-Options\", \"nosniff\")\n219\t        self.send_header(\"Referrer-Policy\", \"no-referrer\")\n220\t        self.end_headers()\n221\t        try:\n222\t            self.wfile.write(body)\n223\t        except (BrokenPipeError, ConnectionResetError):\n224\t            pass\n225\t\n226\t    def _json(self, obj, code=200):\n227\t        self._send(code, _json_bytes(obj))\n228\t\n229\t    def _deny(self, code=403, msg=\"forbidden\"):\n230\t        self._json({\"error\": msg}, code)\n231\t\n232\t    # --- GET (read plane) -------------------------------------------------------------------------\n233\t    def do_GET(self):\n234\t        path = urlparse(self.path).path\n235\t        if path in (\"/\", \"/index.html\"):\n236\t            return self._serve_index()\n237\t        if path.startswith(\"/static/\"):\n238\t            return self._serve_static(path[len(\"/static/\"):])\n239\t        if not path.startswith(\"/api/\"):\n240\t            return self._deny(404, \"not found\")\n241\t        if path == \"/api/stream\":\n242\t            return self._sse()                    # SSE authenticates via ?env= inside _authed\n243\t        if path == \"/api/pending\":\n244\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n245\t                return\n246\t            return self._json({\"pending\": self.server.daemon().pending()})   # {seq,tier,kind} only\n247\t        if path == \"/api/snapshot\":\n248\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n249\t                return\n250\t            from ..dashboard import snapshot\n251\t            return self._json(snapshot(self.server.store()))\n252\t        if path == \"/api/graph\":\n253\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n254\t                return\n255\t            return self._graph()\n256\t        if path.startswith(\"/api/record/\"):\n257\t            if self._authed(\"read:record\") is None:\n258\t                return\n259\t            return self._record(path.rsplit(\"/\", 1)[-1])\n260\t        if path == \"/api/recall\":\n261\t            if self._authed(_READ_ACTION[path]) is None:\n262\t                return\n263\t            subject = self._query().get(\"subject\", [\"\"])[0]\n264\t            return self._json({\"subject\": subject, \"recall\": self.server.daemon().recall(subject)})\n265\t        return self._deny(404, \"unknown endpoint\")\n266\t\n267\t    def _serve_index(self):\n268\t        idx = _WEBAPP / \"index.html\"\n269\t        if not idx.is_file():\n270\t            return self._deny(404, \"bridge PWA not built yet\")   # {"parentUuid":"4e609033-74c1-4020-bc4b-42307933e62b","isSidechain":true,"promptId":"3f8d7a84-2083-490c-adb3-be5a0da7c099","agentId":"a0628aae67f1a382e","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_0113DGSekahyepNCAgQKjuHx","type":"tool_result","content":"1\t\"\"\"Device-signed, replay-resistant request envelope (Phase 9 W1-A) — the bridge auth keystone.\n2\t\n3\tThe phone (a device the owner AUTHORIZED via `sigil.mesh.authorize_device`) signs EACH request to the\n4\tdesktop bridge with ITS OWN Ed25519 key over the canonical envelope core. There is NO wire bearer\n5\tsecret: authentication IS the signature, verified against the owner-minted authorized-device set. This\n6\tmirrors the approval-record pattern (`agents.approvals._approval_message` / `verify_approval`) — same\n7\tcanonical-JSON message, same fail-closed `verify_one`, same trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n8\t(a rogue/revoked device cannot self-authorize; a tampered field breaks the signature).\n9\t\n10\tReplay resistance is a deterministic, spine-anchored monotonic-nonce highwater PER DEVICE, enforced\n11\tATOMICALLY for EFFECTFUL requests: the check-then-receipt runs under the spine lock (re-entrant), so\n12\tconcurrent replays of one captured envelope can't both pass. An effectful request must carry a nonce\n13\tstrictly greater than the highest nonce that device has ever been receipted for. Reads are authenticated\n14\tby signature alone (the transport verifies them without a receipt and bounds their replay with a\n15\ttimestamp window). The receipt is an append-only spine event, so the watermark is tamper-evident memory.\n16\t\n17\tThis module is PURE by construction — NO wallclock, NO RNG. The caller supplies `nonce` and `ts` so the\n18\tJS phone client and Python reproduce the exact signed bytes (the parity contract) and so freshness is a\n19\tdeterministic function of the spine. A wallclock timestamp-WINDOW check (is `ts` recent?) belongs to\n20\tthe server transport layer, not here. Offense-free.\"\"\"\n21\tfrom __future__ import annotations\n22\t\n23\tfrom typing import Set, Tuple, Union\n24\t\n25\tfrom ..reuse import canonical_json, sign, verify_one\n26\tfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n27\t\n28\t# The request vocabulary the bridge accepts — a fail-closed allow-list. `panic`/`relay` are effectful;\n29\t# the `read:*` family is side-effect-free. An action outside this set is refused even if validly signed.\n30\tACTIONS = frozenset({\"panic\", \"relay\", \"read:snapshot\", \"read:pending\", \"read:record\",\n31\t                     \"read:stream\", \"read:recall\"})\n32\t\n33\t# The spine signal marking a consumed request. Its records form the per-device nonce highwater.\n34\tRECEIPT_SIGNAL = \"mesh.request\"\n35\t\n36\t\n37\tdef envelope_message(core: dict) -> bytes:\n38\t    \"\"\"The exact bytes signed/verified — canonical JSON of the core. This is the JS<->Python parity\n39\t    contract: a future JS client MUST produce these identical bytes. Mirrors\n40\t    `agents.approvals._approval_message` (return bytes; encode only if `canonical_json` gave a str).\"\"\"\n41\t    m = canonical_json(core)\n42\t    return m if isinstance(m, bytes) else m.encode()\n43\t\n44\t\n45\tdef build_core(device_pubkey: str, action: str, args: dict, nonce, ts) -> dict:\n46\t    \"\"\"The signed core. `nonce`/`ts` are caller-supplied (this module never reads a clock or RNG).\"\"\"\n47\t    return {\"v\": 1, \"device\": device_pubkey, \"action\": action, \"args\": args, \"nonce\": nonce, \"ts\": ts}\n48\t\n49\t\n50\tdef sign_envelope(device_key, core: dict) -> dict:\n51\t    \"\"\"Phone/test side: attach a DEVICE signature over the canonical core, producing the wire payload.\"\"\"\n52\t    return {**core, \"sig\": sign(device_key.private_key_b64, envelope_message(core))}\n53\t\n54\t\n55\tdef verify_envelope(payload, authorized: Set[str]) -> Tuple[bool, Union[dict, str]]:\n56\t    \"\"\"Fail-closed authentication. Rebuild the core (payload minus `sig`); refuse if there is no sig /\n57\t    no device / the device is not in the owner-minted authorized set; then Ed25519-verify the signature\n58\t    over the canonical core; finally require the (now-authenticated) action to be in the `ACTIONS`\n59\t    allow-list. Mirrors `agents.approvals.verify_approval`. Returns (True, core) or (False, reason).\"\"\"\n60\t    p = payload.payload if hasattr(payload, \"payload\") else payload\n61\t    sig = p.get(\"sig\")\n62\t    device = p.get(\"device\")\n63\t    if not sig or not device or not isinstance(device, str):   # a non-str device would crash the `in authorized` set test\n64\t        return False, \"missing/invalid signature or device\"\n65\t    if device not in authorized:                       # trust pinned to owner-minted device keys\n66\t        return False, \"device is not authorized\"\n67\t    core = {k: v for k, v in p.items() if k != \"sig\"}\n68\t    try:                                               # verify_one RAISES on a malformed-length sig\n69\t        sig_ok = verify_one(device, envelope_message(core), sig)\n70\t    except Exception:  # noqa: BLE001 — any crypto/decode error is a fail-closed refusal, never a crash\n71\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n72\t    if not sig_ok:\n73\t        return False, \"signature invalid\"\n74\t    if core.get(\"action\") not in ACTIONS:              # allow-list the authenticated action (fail-closed)\n75\t        return False, f\"unknown action: {core.get('action')!r}\"\n76\t    return True, core\n77\t\n78\t\n79\tdef record_receipt(store: SpineStore, core: dict) -> int:\n80\t    \"\"\"Append the append-only consumption receipt. Carries only the routing fields — never `args`\n81\t    (which may hold a subject) and never the signature; the record is auto-tier (an A0 event).\"\"\"\n82\t    return store.append(kind=\"event\", source=\"mesh\", actor=\"DEVICE\",\n83\t                        payload={\"signal\": RECEIPT_SIGNAL, \"device\": core[\"device\"],\n84\t                                 \"action\": core[\"action\"], \"nonce\": core[\"nonce\"],\n85\t                                 \"ts\": core[\"ts\"], \"tier\": \"A0\", \"decision\": \"auto\"})\n86\t\n87\t\n88\tdef device_nonce_highwater(store: SpineStore, device_pubkey: str) -> int:\n89\t    \"\"\"The highest receipted nonce for this device (-1 if none, so a first nonce of 0 is valid). Non-int\n90\t    nonces are tolerated (skipped).\"\"\"\n91\t    hi = -1\n92\t    for r in store.iter_records():\n93\t        p = r.payload\n94\t        if p.get(\"signal\") == RECEIPT_SIGNAL and p.get(\"device\") == device_pubkey:\n95\t            try:\n96\t                n = int(p.get(\"nonce\"))\n97\t            except (TypeError, ValueError):\n98\t                continue\n99\t            if n > hi:\n100\t                hi = n\n101\t    return hi\n102\t\n103\t\n104\tdef consume(store: SpineStore, payload, authorized: Set[str], *, effectful: bool) -> dict:\n105\t    \"\"\"Authenticate, gate replay for effectful requests, receipt, return the core. Raises `ValueError`\n106\t    with the refusal reason on any failure (fail-closed). Output shape and filter are byte-for-byte\nunchanged: `{seq, tier, kind}`, only for items that just QUEUED awaiting approval at tier A2/A3.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom typing import List, Optional\n\nfrom ..spine.store import SpineStore\n\n\nclass PushNotifier:\n    def __init__(self, store: Optional[SpineStore] = None, *, since_seq: Optional[int] = None):\n        self.store = store or SpineStore()\n        # Start at the current head (only NEW items push) unless an explicit resume cursor is supplied.\n        # `poll()` advances this cursor over EVERY record it walks, so a subsequent poll never re-emits.\n        self.cursor = since_seq if since_seq is not None else self.store.next_seq - 1\n\n    def poll(self) -> List[dict]:\n        \"\"\"New pushes since the last poll: one per newly-QUEUED A2/A3 item, minimal fields only.\n\n        ONE pass over the spine (`iter_records(since_seq=cursor)`);
